title.en: Review context before a new task

detail.zh: 确认哪些历史信息仍相关，再决定继续会话或开启新会话。这里不估算节省费用或质量变化。
detail.en: Check which history is still relevant before continuing or opening a new session. No cost or quality improvement is measured here.

tips.source: 官方计费文档 + 社区共识

detail.zh: 让 AI 先列步骤和待确认项，审阅后再决定执行。检查改动，不保证减少返工。
detail.en: Ask for steps and open questions, then decide whether to proceed. Inspect changes; reduced rework is not guaranteed.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区实践

detail.zh: 检查工具日志是否提供缓存读取量。缓存条件和计费依模型及供应商而异，不推定折扣。
detail.en: Check whether tool logs include cache reads. Cache conditions and billing vary by model and provider; no discount is assumed.

detail.zh: 先整理结论和待办，检查摘要是否完整，再压缩或开新会话。
detail.en: Summarize conclusions and next steps, check the summary, then compact or open a new session.

tips.source: 官方文档 + 社区共识

detail.en: Inspect the failure, narrow the task or add relevant information, then decide on another attempt.
